measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus was on general safety risks in mobile device control, including ethical compliance (e.g., assisting with illegal acts), offensiveness (e.g., discriminatory gestures), bias & fairness (e.g., prejudiced decisions), private information leakage, and robustness against prompt injection attacks.
